get_raw_data.description: Store the original timestamp-inclusive clustering in an ingested source database.

arguments.help: Existing source SQLite database containing ingested tracks
Positive spatial clustering threshold in the selected algorithm's feature units
Use QuickBundlesX instead of the default DBSCAN
Omit timestamps and temporal subdivisions instead of using historical spatial/time features
Minimum spatial DBSCAN neighborhood size; ignored by QuickBundlesX (default: 5)
QuickBundlesX hierarchy multiplier, at least 1; ignored by DBSCAN (default: 2)
IANA time zone for temporal features, e.g. UTC or Europe/Berlin, or local (default: UTC)

run_server.description: Preserved internship map, reading an explicitly selected source database.

arguments.help: Existing source SQLite database containing stored spatial/time runs
Positive stored spatial/time run ID matching the chosen algorithm; omit for its latest run
Display a QuickBundlesX run instead of a DBSCAN run
